title: Dependency intake form and auto‑escalation runbook for roadmap gating
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Roadmap deliverables across Eng/Design/Security/Infra regularly have implicit, under-documented dependencies. This causes late blockers during rollouts and reactive firefighting during cycles.

Objective: Ship a lightweight dependency intake form + automated escalation runbook that integrates with Linear, Slack, and our roadmap dashboard. The intake will capture owner, expected SLA, blocker severity, required sign-offs (design/security/infra), and gating rules. The automation will notify owners and escalate unresolved items according to a configurable cadence and severity matrix.

Scope: Build intake template (Confluence + an optional embedded Google Form), configure a Linear workflow to record dependency tickets, implement a Slack automation for triage reminders and escalations, and add a dashboard widget for open-dependency counts by team and OKR. Generate clear exception workflow and manual override.

Out of scope: Full two-way sync with third-party project trackers (future work), long-term analytics beyond Q2 baseline, and automated enforcement that blocks deploys (we will start with visibility + human-in-the-loop gating).
acceptance_criteria: Intake form published in Confluence and linked from PRD templates
Linear template created (PM-Dependency) that auto-populates from form responses
Slack triage bot posts to #roadmap-deps with configurable cadence and escalation rules
Dashboard widget in Console shows open dependencies by team, severity, and OKR with drilldowns
Escalation runbook documented with on-call and escalation contacts; security review completed
Pilot with three Q2 initiatives (Serving Runtime, Dedicated Autoscale, Console Rollouts) completed and feedback captured
updates: 2026-02-07: Scoping workshop with Eng/Design/Security/Infra attended by 18 stakeholders. Agreed on minimal required fields and severity tiers (S1-S4). Action: Maya to draft Confluence template.
2026-02-12: Confluence draft live. Design provided a compact intake UI to reduce friction (DES-128). Security flagged PII-handling field; added KMS/handoff checkbox. Assigned to Security for review.

2026-02-20: Linear workflow mock created. Auto-assign rules proposed: dependencies without an owner escalate to Eng steward after 48 hours. Feedback: Infra requests a 72-hour window for infra capacity checks. Decision: 72 hours for infra-only dependencies, 48 hours otherwise.

2026-03-02: Slack bot prototype posts created using roadmap-automation repo. PR opened (see links). Initial cadence: reminder at 24h, escalate at 72h then 120h. UX review requested for message noise management.
2026-03-08: Pilot plan approved with three Q2 initiatives. Dashboard widget schema agreed; analytics team to instrument metrics (open_count, time_to_resolution, escalations).
2026-03-10: Security completed review; minor changes to intake (encryption and data retention fields). Next: finalize runbook and start pilot on 2026-03-17.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Notification fatigue leading to ignored escalations. Mitigation: configurable team-level subscription and summary digests; use severity-based throttling.
Risk: Incorrect mapping from form to Linear creating duplicate tickets. Mitigation: idempotency token and dedupe logic in automation; manual merge instructions in runbook.
Risk: Cross-team ownership disputes. Mitigation: introduce Ownership Arbitration cadence (weekly 30m) and Triage Chair rotation until ownership SLA matures.

Risk: Security/regulatory objections to storing sensitive metadata in third-party forms. Mitigation: store only pointers in Drive, mark sensitive fields as required for on-prem/private deployments and route to KMS-approved storage.

Risk: Dashboards show incomplete picture if teams don’t adopt intake. Mitigation: make intake links part of PRD and release checklist; PMs will validate as 'blocking criteria' during roadmap readouts.
next_steps: Finalize Confluence intake and publish by 2026-03-12
Merge Slack bot PR and release webhook to staging by 2026-03-15
Configure Linear workflow and templates; pilot with ENG-3942, ENG-4010, and PM-33122 starting 2026-03-17
Run 2-week pilot, collect adoption metrics and qualitative feedback, iterate on cadence and message copy
Staff Ownership Arbitration meeting cadence and create recurring invite (owner: Luca Fernandez)
